name: Sid Morrison
summary:
Sidney Wallace Morrison (May 13, 1933 – November 10, 2026) was an American farmer and politician who served as a member of the United States House of Representatives from 1981 to 1993. He was a member of the Republican Party.
Morrison had previously served in both chambers of the Washington State Legislature and later served as Secretary of the Washington State Department of Transportation under Governors Mike Lowry and Gary Locke.
